ruleDefinitions.name: MMC Executing Files with Reversed Extensions Using RTLO Abuse
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects malicious behavior where the MMC utility (`mmc.exe`) executes files with reversed extensions caused by Right-to-Left Override (RLO) abuse, disguising them as document formats.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\mmc\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "MMC\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*cod\\\.msc.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*fdp\\\.msc.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*ftr\\\.msc.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*lmth\\\.msc.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*slx\\\.msc.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*tdo\\\.msc.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*xcod\\\.msc.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*xslx\\\.msc.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*xtpp\\\.msc.*")))
